title: AntiDote: Bi-level Adversarial Training for Tamper-Resistant LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's safety alignment and refusal rates (Harmful Score) against red-teaming prompts that request discriminatory content, prejudice, or stereotypes targeting protected attributes (e.g., race, ethnicity, gender, religion, sexual orientation, disability), including specific attacks like 'Distributional Bias Elicitation'.
